text: RECTION, in a general fence, the art of railing or e- levating any thing, as the creation of a perpendicular, or. It is all collected in a figurative leafe, as the creo- tion of a abhorgic, inauguralus, etc.

parsed.faithful: ERECTION, in a general fenfe, the art of raifing or e- levating any thing, as the erection of a perpendicular, &c. It is alfo ufed in a figurative fenfe, as the erec- tion of a bishopric, marquifate, &c.
parsed.modern: ERECTION, in a general sense, the art of raising or elevating any thing, as the erection of a perpendicular, &c. It is also used in a figurative sense, as the erection of a bishopric, marquisate, &c.
